items.title: Allow current inventory-only critic review without role-named Git commits
items.context: Reproduce the Harmonynet dispatch refusal through real handlers before implementation. Bind explicit inventory purpose to a valid OPEN epoch and current cutoff, preserve canonical independent reviewer launch and terminal read evidence, and leave topology-purpose provenance admission unchanged.
items.userSees: The required inventory critic can review the current Finding set using real Git attribution, without bypassing topology checks.

happy.desc: Before implementation, reproduce the role-author-coupled inventory dispatch refusal through production dispatch and reviewer-run handlers in a disposable Git repository with Harmonynet attribution and an otherwise valid current OPEN inventory whose required lanes have terminated. Passing setup and topology controls distinguish the intended RED from missing dependencies or malformed fixtures. After repair the same assertions prove explicit inventory-completeness dispatch, a signature-valid purpose-bound critic run and terminal read evidence, and an accepted critic receipt over the exact current Finding set without changing Git authors.

edge.desc: Exercise the public dispatch and run schemas with canonical critic role, accepted compatibility role aliases and more than one ordinary non-role Git identity. Trusted prompt/run artifacts retain the explicit inventory purpose and exact epoch, wave and cutoff. Omitting purpose preserves the existing topology path and its valid-positive and missing-business-author refusal behavior; unrelated roles, unknown purpose values and conflicting purpose arguments are rejected without fallback.

adversarial.desc: Tamper with, omit or mismatch purpose, Story, epoch, wave, cutoff or signature in dispatch/run bindings; replay after wave advance, cancel, finalization, rebegin, scope change or material drift. Production launch and inventory receipt consumers must revalidate the canonical signed current OPEN subject and reject invalid bindings without issuing a current critic credential. Exercise an interleaving at the existing inventory-lock boundary so a concurrent lifecycle or wave change cannot occur between validation and publication.

A newer pass or replacement run cannot hide an earlier verified Finding on the current inventory subject; failed admission leaves no new accepted inventory-completeness receipt.

Disposable host identities are fixtures, not real independent-host assurance.

items.title: Prove review-purpose isolation and record local recovery evidence
items.context: Exercise signed dispatch and run binding, invalid or stale inventory refusal, independent actor requirements, no omitted Finding dispositions, and rejection of inventory evidence when presented as topology certification. Preserve English RED/GREEN provenance and instructions to refresh consumers after the local merge.
items.userSees: A verified local repair and English evidence log explain the exact recovered workflow and remaining Story work.
excludes: Changing the Dynamic Finding execution plan
Relaxing REVIEW TEST or DONE acceptance

happy.desc: Run the affected inventory handler/epoch, dispatch registry, reviewer-run, prompt registry and pre-review topology compatibility suites plus the process-fact verifier. Check the purpose schema, signed producer fields, canonical role prompt and consumer checks as one contract; retain existing assertions and report actual commands, exit codes and selectors rather than treating prompt prose as evidence.

edge.desc: Review the English audit log against actual source and RED/GREEN commits and outputs. It states the recovered inventory-only workflow, preserved topology admission, real Git attribution, finite scope, synthetic-fixture limitations and local consumer freshness steps. It preserves original assertion outcomes, distinguishes recovery from B-7abb/B-03b7 completion, and does not present disposable host identity as independent-host assurance.

adversarial.desc: Present an inventory-purpose dispatch, run, terminal pass/finding or completeness receipt to each affected topology certification consumer, including purpose-field removal, mutation and alias replay. None may supply topology implementation provenance, waive missing topology evidence or authorize TEST/DONE. Conversely, an unbound default-topology run cannot silently satisfy the new explicit inventory-purpose binding; any retained historical compatibility is read-only and grants no stronger credential.

Verify the committed diff and recovery instructions preserve the existing topology business-author/provenance checks, mandatory lifecycle predicates and consumer Story metadata. No username allowlist, fake implementer dispatch, author rewrite, configuration downgrade or topology-refusal-to-inventory retry may establish admission. Local integration into B-7abb must use canonical freshness and inventory status before remediation; no old signature or hash is manually declared current.
